tasks.label: Format Solution
tasks.command: dotnet format whitespace StatePie.sln --include src tests examples

tasks.label: Lint Solution
tasks.command: dotnet format style StatePie.sln --include src tests examples --verify-no-changes --no-restore --severity warn

tasks.label: Lint Fix Solution
tasks.command: dotnet format style StatePie.sln --include src tests examples --no-restore --severity warn

tasks.label: Sync develop with main
args: $changes = @(git status --porcelain); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $unexpectedChanges = @($changes | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^.{3}\.vscode/tasks\.json$' }); if ($unexpectedChanges.Count -gt 0) { Write-Error 'Commit or stash changes other than .vscode/tasks.json before syncing develop.'; exit 1 }; git fetch origin; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git switch develop; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push origin develop; exit $LASTEXITCODE
